note: A cohort study of prenatal isolated horseshoe kidney detected a pathogenic PSMD12 variant in 1 of 45 exome-sequenced cases (1 of 95 total fetuses), confirming PSMD12 as a rare cause (<5%) of isolated fetal HSK.

evidence.text: In a study of 95 fetuses with isolated horseshoe kidney, 45 CMA-negative cases underwent trio exome sequencing, identifying one disease-causing splice variant (c.796-1G > A) in PSMD12.

source.title: Clinically Significant Genetic Results in Fetuses With Isolated Horseshoe Kidney
source.quote: Among the cases that yielded negative results from CMA, 45 proceeded to trio ES. Notably, two disease-causing variants, c.796-1G > A in PSMD12 and c.11707 C > T (p.Gln3903*) in KMT2D, were detected in each case.
